Inside, a note curled tight as a snail shell. His hands shook as he unrolled it. The ink had faded, but the words held: Still here. Still waiting. No name, no date. He read it three times, then looked out at the grey water that gave him nothing back. For forty years he had warned ships away from these rocks, a solitary life measured in turns of the lamp. Now someone, somewhere, had thrown a question into the sea and trusted the current. He fetched paper, wrote two words, and sealed them in the same bottle. Me too.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下一串渐远的光。便利店的灯亮着，店员靠在柜台后打盹。环卫工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。高楼大多黑着窗，只有零星几盏灯还醒着，不知是失眠的人，还是加班的人。天边泛起一点灰蓝，鸟还没有叫。这是城市最温柔也最孤独的时刻，一切都在等待黎明。", "w03": "• Imagine standing between two mirrors: you see yourself, inside yourself, inside yourself, going smaller and smaller.\n• Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a tinier copy of itself to do a tinier piece.\n• It only stops when the copy gets so small the answer is obvious, like counting down to zero."}
